List BEDsets

Source: R/bedbaser.R
bb_list_bedsets.Rd

List BEDsets available through bedhost. By default uses the bedhost default of 1000 records and an initial offset of 0.

bb_list_bedsets(bedbase, query = "", limit = 1000, offset = 0)

Arguments

bedbase

BEDbase() object

query

character() (default "") keyword

limit

integer(1) (default 1000) maximum records

offset

integer(1) (default 0) page token of records

Value

tibble of BEDset records

Examples

bedbase <- BEDbase()
#> 125977 BED files available.
bb_list_bedsets(bedbase)
#> # A tibble: 1,000 × 9
#> # Groups:   id, name, md5sum, submission_date, last_update_date, description,
